title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass | Fire Engine Red | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Clear counter clutter and add everyday storage with this wall-mounted glass shelf—also a bathroom shelf or wall shelf—with an integrated towel bar (towel rack/towel holder) for towels at the sink in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. Designed for the Waverly Place collection, it coordinates easily with matching Waverly Place pieces and complements transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Depend on solid brass hardware and brass construction for lasting wall-hanging support
- Save space with a wall mount / wall-mounted installation

Specs & Installation:
- Shelf dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Glass thickness: 3/8 inch (0.38 in)
- Projection from wall: 5 inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4)
- Assembly required: no
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
